Circle ’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
What you’ll be responsible for:
Circle is looking for a Regulatory and Licensing Program Manager to drive our licensing applications from filing strategy through to approval. Every new license, registration, or charter is a multi-month program on a regulatory clock, and it pulls in work from teams across the company. You will have early visibility into sensitive business and regulatory decisions. Handling that information with discretion is a core part of the role.

This is a program management role that requires real regulatory depth. You will run several applications at once and set the standard every future one follows. Regional policy and legal leaders own the strategy and the regulator relationship; you make the program move. We use AI heavily on this team and expect you to do the same. It is how a portfolio this wide stays manageable.

• Facilitating working sessions and executive steering committee briefings that drive programs forward, from setting the agenda and framing decisions to closing the loop on outcomes.

• Tracking and managing risks across all active programs, owning the escalation path and getting the right people involved early.

• Establishing and evolving scalable service standards for how Circle runs regulatory and licensing programs.

• Supporting, as directed, in external procurement activities across scoping, contracting, budget, and delivery.

• Strengthening how the global policy organization works: bringing the same discipline to consultations, submissions, briefings and events, and to whatever else the team needs run well.

• Ensure that all processing and reporting deadlines are consistently achieved.

title: Web Designer
description:

Rythm is the fastest-growing lab in America. We redefined at-home testing with the world’s easiest blood test and created a culture around monthly lab testing from home. We’ve processed millions of tests across all 50 states, and we do everything in-house, from sample testing and logistics to code, marketing, and design. That vertical integration gives us the speed, control, and creativity to shape the future of health and wellness.
THE ROLE
We’re looking for an exceptional Web Designer to own and elevate our digital experience across web. This is a highly hands-on role for a designer with strong visual instincts, deep UX/UI expertise, and a portfolio that demonstrates the ability to create polished, intuitive, high-performing consumer experiences.
You’ll work cross-functionally with Brand, Growth, Product, and Engineering to translate business goals and brand strategy into thoughtful digital experiences. The ideal candidate brings a strong point of view, sweats the details, and understands how great design can simultaneously strengthen a brand, simplify the customer journey, and drive conversion.
WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own web design from concept through final execution across the website, landing pages, campaigns, launches, and other digital experiences.

• Create wireframes, user flows, high-fidelity designs, prototypes, and production-ready assets in Figma.

• Design beautiful, intuitive experiences across desktop and mobile.

• Translate brand identity into a cohesive and distinctive digital experience.

• Develop and evolve scalable design systems, components, and patterns.

• Partner closely with Growth and Marketing to design landing pages and experiences optimized for engagement and conversion.

• Collaborate with developers throughout implementation, providing clear design specifications and ensuring the final experience meets the intended design.

• Use customer behavior, performance data, testing, and feedback to continuously improve the site experience.

• Balance brand storytelling, usability, and commercial goals when making design decisions.

• Maintain an exceptionally high bar for typography, hierarchy, layout, interaction, and visual consistency.

• Stay current on emerging web design, UX/UI, e-commerce, and digital design trends.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• 5+ years of experience in web, digital, UX/UI, or product design, ideally within a consumer-facing or high-growth brand.

• An exceptional portfolio demonstrating sophisticated web design, strong visual craft, and thoughtful UX/UI decision-making.

• Expert-level proficiency in Figma.

• Experience designing consumer websites, landing pages, and conversion-focused digital experiences.

• Strong understanding of design systems and component-based design.

• Excellent typography, composition, hierarchy, and visual storytelling skills.

• Experience partnering closely with developers and creating clean, implementation-ready design files.

• Ability to move quickly, manage multiple priorities, and iterate without sacrificing quality.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly articulate the thinking behind design decisions.

• A high level of taste and attention to detail.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?
Rythm Health offers a benefits package which includes:

• Highly competitive base salary.

• Equity: meaningful equity stake aligned with the scope and seniority of this role.

• Flexible, remote-friendly work environment.

• Meaningful work that genuinely impacts people’s lives.

• Monthly Rythm Health membership with full access to at-home blood testing and personalized health insights.

• Unlimited vacation policy.

• 401(k).

• The opportunity to help define the future of personalized health.

• High ownership and visibility from day one.

• Small, collaborative, mission-driven team.

• Ability to shape both product and design culture early.

We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA
“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP
“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

• Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (NPs and PAs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Board certification (required)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

description:
Floowi connects top LATAM professionals with leading U.S. companies through remote talent solutions. Our mission is to make LATAM the world’s premier hub for growth and excellence.
🌟 About our Client:
Our client specializes in performance-based customer database monetization, helping businesses generate recurring revenue from existing customer lists through consent-based marketing campaigns. Its multichannel approach includes email, SMS, and paid media, with campaigns funded by the company and revenue shared with its partners.
✍ Short Description:
We are looking for an Email Infrastructure & Deliverability Specialist to build, launch, and manage a high-volume email-sending infrastructure from the ground up. This role will own the technical setup and ongoing operation of the email-sending environment, including the selection and configuration of appropriate sending platforms and infrastructure. The specialist will manage campaigns across new and legacy contact lists, with a focus on inbox placement, sender reputation, and reliable delivery at scale. The goal is to establish a sustainable email operation capable of supporting approximately 300,000-500,000 emails per day while maintaining strong deliverability and responsible list management.
🌎 Location: 100% Remote (LATAM only)
🗣 Language Requirements: Advanced English (C1+)
⏰ Schedule: Full-time, aligned with EST
😀 Start Date: ASAP
💰 Compensation & Benefits:

• Competitive salary in USD, starting at $3,750/month

• Remote-first flexibility. Work from anywhere.

• PTO and paid U.S. holidays

💼 Responsibilities:

• Build and implement the email-sending infrastructure from scratch, selecting and configuring the platforms and technical components required for high-volume email delivery.

• Configure and maintain email authentication and sending infrastructure to support reliable delivery and protect sender reputation.

• Develop and manage a scalable sending operation capable of supporting approximately 300,000-500,000 emails per day.

• Plan, execute, and monitor bulk email campaigns across new and legacy contact lists, managing sending volumes and delivery performance.

• Monitor inbox placement, sender reputation, bounces, complaints, and other deliverability metrics to identify issues and implement corrective actions.

• Maintain and optimize the infrastructure and sending processes on an ongoing basis, adapting operations to campaign performance and evolving delivery requirements.

• Review, segment, and manage contact lists based on data quality, consent status, and engagement considerations to support sustainable campaign performance.

💡 Qualifications:

• Demonstrated experience building email-sending infrastructure from scratch and managing it on an ongoing basis.

• Proven experience operating high-volume email campaigns, ideally at a scale comparable to hundreds of thousands of emails per day.

• Strong technical knowledge of email deliverability, inbox placement, sender reputation, and email authentication protocols, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.

• Hands-on experience configuring and managing bulk email-sending platforms and the infrastructure required to operate them at scale.

• Experience monitoring delivery metrics, troubleshooting deliverability issues, and optimizing sending practices based on performance data.

• Experience managing new and legacy contact lists, including list quality, segmentation, consent considerations, bounces, and unsubscribe management.

📩 If you meet the experience outlined above, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply, our team is excited about your application and will be in touch as soon as possible.

Job Location: Work at Home, Pennsylvania, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care. You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors. Job highlights The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen. In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment: As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants. Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health “Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD “The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

• Health, dental and vision insurance

• Paid time off

• Malpractice coverage

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

title: Director, Clinical Operations

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. SOPs, Systems & Change Management

• Own the clinical SOP lifecycle: intake, drafting with clinical owners, approval, rollout, and retirement, with Guru as the system of record.

title: Growth Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Wir verwalten über 70.000 Einheiten in ganz Deutschland. Das ist nicht das Geschäft, das ist die Plattform. Darauf bauen wir neue Verticals auf: Versicherung, Energie, Finanzierung und Brokerage. Für Brokerage suchen wir jetzt die Person, die daraus ein echtes Geschäft macht.

Darum geht es

Viele unserer Eigentümer wollen irgendwann verkaufen oder neu vermieten. Wir sitzen direkt an der Quelle und kennen Objekte, Eigentümer und Timing. Deine Aufgabe ist, daraus eine planbare Akquise-Maschine zu bauen: Du identifizierst die richtigen Eigentümer aus unserem Bestand, sprichst sie gezielt an und wandelst erstes Interesse in hochqualifizierte Leads für unsere Makler um.

Das ist keine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien und Roadmaps. Du baust selbst: Kampagnen, Outbound-Workflows, Automatisierungen, Funnels. Du weißt jede Woche, welche Zahl du bewegt hast. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership-Team, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen.

Was du machst

- Akquise-Engine aufbauen: Du analysierst unseren Bestand, findest Eigentümer mit Verkaufs- oder Vermietungsbedarf und baust Workflows für Datenanreicherung, Lead-Scoring und automatisierte Ansprache.

- Marketing selbst umsetzen: Du baust und optimierst die Kanäle, die Leads bringen, von Outbound über Performance-Kampagnen bis zu In-App-Triggern im richtigen Moment.

- Funnel und Zahlen verantworten: Du definierst KPIs vom Lead bis zum Mandat, trackst Kosten pro Lead und Conversion und optimierst so lange, bis die Unit Economics stimmen.

- Schnell testen: Daten-Trigger, Kanäle, Messaging und Lead-Magneten. Du hast eine klare Meinung, was du ausprobieren willst, und misst es sauber.

Was du mitbringst

- 3+ Jahre operative Erfahrung in Growth oder Performance Marketing, mit eigener Verantwortung für Leads, Conversion oder Umsatz.

- Du hast Dinge von null aufgebaut, etwa als Gründer:in, als Geschäftsführer:in eines kleinen Unternehmens oder in einer frühen Startup-Phase. Das ist für uns ein starkes Signal.

- Hands-on-Erfahrung mit datengetriebener Akquise: Outbound, Datenanreicherung, CRM und Automatisierung.

- Marketing-Erfahrung mit Performance-Kanälen und Kampagnen ist ein klares Plus.

- Erfahrung in Immobilien, PropTech oder Marktplätzen ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

- Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mindestens C1). Du sprichst täglich mit Eigentümern und unseren Hausverwaltungen.

- Du lebst in Berlin oder ziehst her und reist gern zu unseren Standorten in ganz Deutschland.

Bitte nicht bewerben, wenn

- du vor allem Strategie machen und die Umsetzung anderen überlassen willst,

- du erst ein Team führen möchtest, bevor das Modell bewiesen ist,

- du nicht bereit bist, in Berlin zu arbeiten.

Was wir bieten

- Ein Vertical, das du von Anfang an prägst, mit 70.000 Einheiten als Basis und voller Rückendeckung vom Leadership-Team.

- Ein Inside-Sales-Team, auf das du zugreifen kannst: Es übernimmt Anrufe und die Bearbeitung deiner Kampagnen, damit du dich auf den Aufbau der Akquise-Engine konzentrieren kannst.

- Einen direkten Weg zur Verantwortung: Wenn Brokerage funktioniert, skalierst du es weiter.

- Top-Vergütung inklusive virtueller Aktienoptionen und 500 € Wohnzuschuss pro Monat in der Nähe unseres Büros.

- 110 € Lunch-Budget und 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss pro Monat, täglich Frühstück und Spezialitäten-Kaffee im Office.

- 1.200 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr.

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Every transaction at Nubank travels across a network before it reaches a customer. As we grow across countries, accounts, regions and hybrid environments, the connectivity layer underneath has to stay fast, segmented, auditable and cheap to run - while never becoming the thing that takes the platform down.

As a Lead Software Engineer on a Cloud Network platform engineering team, you set and evolve the technical direction for how Nubank connects its cloud, hybrid and on-premises environments. You own problems whose scope spreads across several teams and business units, and you are expected to bring structure to ambiguity rather than wait for it to be resolved for you.

This is an IC6 role: you lead through technical depth, design authority and influence rather than direct reports. The goal you own is a cloud network platform that scales with the business, holds up under audit, and gets simpler over time instead of more complex.

YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Setting and evolving the technical direction of the cloud network platform owned by your team, aligning with Nubank's canonical approaches and contributing back to the broader technical community.

- Leading high-level and low-level design for connectivity patterns across multi-account, multi-region, multi-geo and hybrid-cloud topologies, independently making sound architectural decisions in multi-component, multi-team designs.

- Managing complex network projects and processes end to end - working independently, coordinating across subjects and stakeholders, and escalating for managerial support in a timely way rather than reactively.

- Proactively reducing long-term complexity through simplification, consolidation, deprecation and paved roads, explicitly balancing scalability, maintainability and cost, and considering both human and AI interaction with the platform.

- Owning the operational health of the network platform in your team's scope: leading complex incident response (diagnosis, coordination, resolution), driving complex postmortems, and owning the short- and long-term tech debt strategy that comes out of them.

- Promoting a culture of safe change - feature flags, gradual rollout, monitoring, fast rollback - applied to network changes, and driving simplification and cost optimization across the topology.

- Setting and enforcing quality standards for the team's automation and infrastructure code: testing practices, code review bar, reusable modules, and anticipation of quality and maintainability needs coming from business strategy.

- Defining observability for the platform - robust monitoring, controls and SLAs that surface issues proactively rather than after customer impact.

- Bringing a strong end-to-end domain understanding: tracing a business process from product through the transactional path down to the network and data layers, and understanding how network design choices propagate through it.

- Owning the network security posture of your scope, including PCI DSS or equivalent standards, segmentation, and controls that hold up under audit.

- Evaluating buy vs. build options and new products and technologies, being data-driven about stability, reliability, scalability and cost before committing to a solution.

- Mentoring IC4/IC5 engineers on the broader system landscape, design reasoning and operational practice, and raising the bar of the people around you.

title: Technical Co-founder (CTO) - AI Collections Agent
description:
The Opportunity
Finance teams at B2B companies lose cash the same way every month: an invoice ages past 45 days, someone sends an email, no reply, someone calls, voicemail, they call again next week, still nothing. AR teams spend 60-70% of their week on manual follow-up instead of posting cash, closing disputes, or analyzing aging. Adding headcount doesn't fix it; manual follow-up simply doesn't scale, and every ERP hits the same wall.
Problem and solution validation are complete. Live pilots are running with early design partners and entering production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, and scalability. The teams that ship credible AI workers into finance-sensitive functions in the next 18 months will define the category. We intend to be one of them.
The Venture
Argentl delivers an AI collections agent that handles outbound debtor follow-up automatically - trained, monitored, and continuously improved by our team. Rather than another self-serve SaaS tool, Argentl is evaluated on outcomes: DSO reduction, hours returned to the AR team, and cash commitments captured - not configuration effort.
Give us a list of overdue accounts and our voice agent calls each debtor, confirms invoice awareness, and captures exactly what they say - a payment commitment, a dispute, a request to split, or silence. The AR team gets a clean morning report: who's committed, who's disputing, who's gone silent, and what to do next. No ERP migration, no system credentials, no workflow overhaul - we're calling within a week of receiving the data. The roadmap expands from collections follow-up into adjacent AI finance-ops roles, all delivered through the same managed model.
The Partnership
The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, and live pilots are running. What remains is to bring on the technical co-founder - a partner who will own product and engineering with the same conviction, urgency, and ownership stake.
This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.
What you'll own
As Co-Founder & CTO, you will take over the production code and continue building the product (the first lines of production code), set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

• Architecture & Reliability - Harden the voice and workflow systems for in-production reliability. Establish core architecture, observability, and audit-trail standards for a product that speaks to customers' debtors on their behalf.

• Delivery Layer - Build the internal infrastructure that lets the team configure, monitor, and optimize agent performance without scaling engineering headcount. Mature the workflow engine so every call, intent classification, and next-action flows through reliably.

• Integrations & Distribution - Own the accounting and ERP integration layer (QuickBooks, Xero, and beyond) that turns Argentl from a CSV upload into an embedded part of the finance stack - the primary distribution unlock.

• Unit Economics - Own the trade-offs between AI quality and cost-per-call, and lock in unit economics within a productized monthly pricing model.

• Customer & Market - Represent the company in front of finance leaders, partners, and investors as the technical voice of the venture.

• Roadmap - Convert pilots into paying customers, expand the AI staff beyond collections, and begin a path toward custom and self-hosted models where data-privacy and financial-compliance requirements demand it.

ROLE SUMMARY

Join our Builder Platform Team as a Senior Staff Software Engineer. Our mission is to empower a company of builders by delivering a frictionless, standardized, and governed platform for agents, workflows, and core engineering tools. We operate Temporal as customer zero: we partner directly with teams across the company to run their real work on the platform, measure the productivity it unlocks, and feed what we learn back into Temporal’s products and open-source frameworks our customers can adopt.

This is a company-level technical leadership role spanning Agents & Workflows, AI Infrastructure, Developer Infrastructure, and Productivity Engineering. You will set the multi-year technical direction for the platform, align teams around clear architectural boundaries and standards, and lead major cross-functional initiatives from ambiguous opportunity through durable adoption and measurable impact.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Set and communicate a multi-year technical vision for the Builder Platform, translating company strategy into an executable portfolio across Agents & Workflows, AI Infrastructure, Developer Infrastructure, and Productivity Engineering.

- Lead the architecture and evolution of our Agent Platform, the shared foundation teams across Temporal use to deploy, run, evaluate, govern, and improve their agents and agentic workflows.

- Establish and operate our AI Infrastructure, the LLM and MCP gateways every agent and workflow at Temporal runs through, with guardrails, fallback, usage and cost controls, model rollout policies, and clear SLOs.

- Implement AI Governance in partnership with Security, Legal, and IT, turning policy into practical controls, approved patterns, and auditability without creating unnecessary barriers.

- Architect the agents and workflows that carry engineering work from issue to production and business work from trigger to outcome, and decide which patterns graduate into shared platform capabilities and which stay with the teams that own them.

- Own the technical strategy for our Developer Infrastructure (Source Control and CI) and developer tools, including repository standards, access and ownership models, reusable workflows, and CI reliability and cost.

- Partner with leaders across Engineering, Product, Sales, and G&A to identify where AI can accelerate work and improve outcomes, and prioritize those opportunities into a company-wide portfolio.

- Standardize how Temporal adopts agents and agentic tooling (best practices, paved roads, and enablement), driving adoption across the organization through influence rather than mandate.

- Define clear architectural and organizational boundaries across the platform (what is centralized, standardized as a paved road, federated to teams, purchased, or deliberately not built) and make the hard tradeoffs among speed, flexibility, reliability, security, cost, and long-term maintainability.

- Measure the platform on outcomes (adoption, velocity, reliability, and cost), with feedback loops that quantify the productivity it unlocks and shape the portfolio.

- Own our customer-zero strategy: turn what we learn into validated requirements for Temporal Cloud, the SDKs, and our Agent Harness, drive the feedback loop with product leadership, lead our open-source reference architecture for customer platform teams, and represent the strategy with customers, partners, and the broader technical community.

- Develop senior technical leaders, create alignment among engineering leads and managers, and make teams more effective without relying on direct authority.

- Participate in on-call rotation while leading systemic improvements that reduce operational burden, address risks before they become company-wide problems, and improve the internal user experience.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of setting technical direction and delivering major platform initiatives across multiple engineering teams.

title: Local Reporting Network Fellow
description:
ProPublica is an independent, nonprofit newsroom that produces investigative journalism in the public interest.

ProPublica ’s Local Reporting Network helps produce vital, investigative journalism in communities where such stories would otherwise not be done. Now entering its ninth year, the program will be taking on 15 new partnerships over the course of 2026.
Applications for all 15 projects are open now and will be considered on a rolling basis using the deadlines below. There will be three fellowship periods and we will select five fellows for each round:

• Spring cohort - This round is now closed.

•
Application deadline: Rolling, no later than Feb. 5, 2026, by 11:59 p.m. ET.

•
Open to: All applicants from English-language local and regional newsrooms in the United States and its territories.

•
Fellowship dates: April 1, 2026, through March 31, 2027.

• Summer cohort. This round is now closed

•
Application deadline: Rolling, no later than May 1, 2026.

•
Open to: Newsrooms in the states listed as eligible through our 50 State Initiative.

•
Fellowships dates: July 1, 2026, through June 30, 2027.

• Fall cohort

•
Application deadline: Rolling, no later thanJuly 27, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. ET.

•
Open to: Newsrooms in the remaining states listed as eligible through our 50 State Initiative. (Note: This list of states will be updated in July 2025.)

•
Fellowship dates: Oct. 1, 2026, through Sept. 30, 2027.

For these partnerships, ProPublica will provide a grant, to be paid in monthly installments, to the selected newsroom reflecting the annual salary (up to $80,000 plus a 25% allowance for benefits) for one full-time reporter in each newsroom. Successful candidates will have a proven track record of investigative reporting and impact, and will provide a memo about the project they’re proposing working on for the duration of the one-year partnership.
Strong applications will express why the project needs to be told in your community - we’re eager for projects that can’t be done anywhere else. They will also explain how the project would benefit from this collaboration, potentially including the role that our data, research and engagement reporting resources could play, and they will discuss how the project may resonate with both local and national audiences.
Once accepted, local reporters will work from and report to their home newsrooms while receiving extensive support and guidance for their work from ProPublica , including collaboration with a senior editor and access to the nonprofit newsroom’s expertise. The work will be published or broadcast by your newsroom and simultaneously by ProPublica .
ProPublica reporters and editors are available to answer questions or to give you feedback on your application before you submit it. Please reach us at .
We are unable to accept applications via email. No phone calls, please.

We know there are great candidates who may not fit into what we’ve described above or who have important skills we haven’t thought of. If that’s you, don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself.

We are dedicated to improving our newsroom, in part by better reflecting the people we cover. (Here is a breakdown of our staff.) We are committed to diversity and building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and ages. And we are taking steps to meet that commitment. We especially encourage members of traditionally underrepresented communities to apply, including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ people and people with disabilities. We are an equal opportunity employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age or any other status protected under applicable law.

Job Title: Scrum Master
Term: 12 months
Location: Nairobi, Kenya
Reports to: Technical Program Manager
Level: Intermediate/ Senior (4-8 years of relevant experience).
Key Responsibilities

• Facilitate and coordinate Scrum ceremonies (Daily Scrum, Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, Retrospective) with clear agendas, time-boxing, and documented outcomes (decisions, risks, actions, owners, due dates).

• Own and maintain the team's delivery metrics dashboard (sprint velocity, burndown/burnup, defect rates, cycle time, cumulative flow), surfacing trends and escalating concerns to the TPM.

• Actively identify, track, and remove constraints blocking squad members from delivering sprint goals; escalate cross-organizational blockers to the TPM within agreed SLAs.

• Coach squad members and relevant stakeholders on agile principles, Scrum practices, and delivery best practices, progressively building internal agile capability.

• Facilitate cross-squad coordination where multiple technical work streams (Backend, Frontend, API, Data) have interdependent sprint commitments.

• Support knowledge transfer by ensuring that process documentation, decision logs, and sprint artefacts are maintained in the agreed shared workspace.

• Report on delivery health metrics at fortnightly steering cadence, partnering with the TPM for programme-level reporting.

Measurable Outcomes & Deliverables
First 30 Days

• Attend all Scrum ceremonies and produce baseline assessment of ceremony health, compliance, and documentation gaps.

• Own the delivery metrics dashboard and report on velocity, burndown, defect rates, and cycle time and report any present gaps.

• Produce a cross-squad dependency register across Backend, Frontend, API, and Data workstreams.

• Confirm fortnightly steering cadence with the TPM and key stakeholders.

Days 31-60

• Sprint velocity stabilizing; at least two consecutive sprints with 80% sprint goal achievement.

• DoD compliance rate tracked and reported; 90% of completed stories meet DoD criteria.

• Backlog health confirmed: two sprints of stories refined and sprint-ready at all times.

• At least one agile coaching session delivered to client counterparts or junior squad members.

• Delivery metrics dashboard live and shared with TPM and stakeholders.

Days 61-90

• Retrospective improvement actions tracked; demonstrable improvement in at least two delivery metrics since sprint 1.

• Agile maturity assessment (informal) of squad completed; coaching plan for remaining engagement period produced.

• All sprint ceremonies running to time and rated as useful by squad members (informal pulse check).

• Knowledge transfer - one squad member or stakeholder who has visibly adopted improved Scrum practices through coaching

Ongoing KPIs

• Enable the squad to consistently achieve agreed sprint goals through effective planning and execution.

• Ensure stories meet the agreed Definition of Done before acceptance.

• Proactively identify, escalate, and facilitate resolution of delivery blockers and dependencies.

• Maintain a healthy, prioritized backlog that supports upcoming sprint planning and delivery.

• Drive continuous improvement by facilitating effective sprint ceremonies and retrospectives and ensuring agreed improvement actions are followed through.

Stakeholders & Ways of Working
Agile Ceremonies Owned: Sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement.
Reporting Cadence:

• Fortnightly delivery health summary to TPM.

• Sprint metrics dashboard updated at end of each sprint.

• Ad-hoc impediment escalation to TPM as required.

Cross-Functional Touchpoints:

• All squad roles (API Engineer, Backend, Frontend, Data Scientist, UI/UX Designer).

• Product Owners and stakeholders attending sprint reviews.

• TPM for programme-level dependency and risk alignment.

Required Skills & Experience

Technology-driven trends such as diverse mobility, electrification and connectivity will revolutionize the mobility industry in the next decade. Volkswagen Group, as world leader in the automotive industry, is setting the pace for this revolution.

The Project

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Peraton Overview
Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.
Responsibilities
Peraton is looking for a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to lead proactive threat hunting, vulnerability analysis, and remediation in support of a multi-cloud environment with 70+ customer tenants and growing. Aside from technical qualifications, the applicant should have effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
The applicant must have hands-on security experience across multiple cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) and expertise with Qualys and Tenable for vulnerability management. This role goes beyond scanning: the engineer will form and test threat hypotheses, correlate vulnerability, configuration, and log data to find active or likely compromise, and drive findings through to verified remediation. An investigative mindset, strong analytical skills, and attention to detail are prerequisites for this position.
The Senior Security Engineer will collaborate closely with our customers, internal engineering and patching teams, and ISSOs/ISSMs to ensure threats are identified early, risk is prioritized accurately, and remediation is completed and documented.

• Analyze cloud-native telemetry (AWS CloudTrail and GuardDuty, Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Azure Monitor, Google Security Command Center, OCI Cloud Guard and Audit logs) alongside SIEM data to investigate suspicious activity

• Administer and optimize Qualys and Tenable (Tenable.io/Tenable.sc/Nessus) scanning across all cloud tenants, including scan policies, agent and connector deployment, asset coverage, and credentialed scanning

• Analyze vulnerability and configuration findings, eliminate false positives, and prioritize remediation by exploitability, asset criticality, and exposure, including CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV)

• Lead remediation of identified threats and vulnerabilities, working with engineering and patching teams to patch, harden, or apply compensating controls, and verify closure through rescanning

• Identify and remediate cloud misconfigurations, excessive IAM permissions, exposed services, and STIG/CIS benchmark deviations

• Develop and tune detection rules, queries, and automated hunt playbooks so successful hunts become repeatable detections

• Support incident response as a senior technical resource, including scoping, containment recommendations, and root cause analysis

• Produce hunt reports, remediation tracking, and POA&M inputs, and brief findings and risk to customers, ISSOs/ISSMs, and leadership

• Mentor junior security engineers in threat hunting techniques, vulnerability analysis, and tool usage

Qualifications
Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelors degree and 12 years of experience or a Masters degree and 10 years of experience or an As

description: Worum geht es? Wenn in der Schweiz eine Feuerwehr alarmiert wird, läuft die Meldung mit hoher Wahrscheinlichkeit über unsere Systeme. Über uns Die EvoSys AG wurde 2011 gegründet und entwickelt seit 2016 eigene Software für Behörden und Organisationen für Rettung und Sicherheit (BORS). Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen in Thun mit 9 Mitarbeitenden und in unserem Markt führend. Unsere Produkte heissen AlarmHub, Intervento, FloriPlan, AlarmDisplay und SpotPilot. title: Customer Lead
description:
SUMMARY
Join Quorso at a pivotal moment in our growth. We're helping some of the world's most respected retailers transform the way they run their stores, making operations more data-led, agile and impactful. Using Quorso 's intelligent management platform, you'll help turn vast amounts of retail data into clear, actionable insights that influence decisions from store level to the C-suite.
We're already powering performance for some of the biggest names in retail, including Dollar General, PetSmart, Tractor Supply Company and Circle K, and we're now expanding our data capability in the US to support new global growth.
ABOUT QUORSO
Quorso is one of retail’s most exciting SaaS scale-ups. Our intelligent management platform translates terabytes of data into smart, personalised daily actions across more than 60,000 stores worldwide. Backed by Summit Partners, we’re scaling fast and building the data foundations that will shape the future of retail performance.
ABOUT THE ROLEThis role sits at the heart of Quorso ’s customer relationships. Your portfolio will be across large enterprise retail customers. This isn’t a support role. You’ll be the person clients rely on: the one who keeps things moving and spots risks before they escalate. If you want to grow fast and own something meaningful, this is the role for you.
WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own your accounts end to end: run weekly working sessions, manage the client relationship, and make day-to-day decisions with real autonomy

• Build trusted relationships across each client organization, from day-to-day users to senior decision-makers, so daily work ladders up to their strategic goals

• Prepare and lead client meetings: own the agenda, drive the conversation, and leave every session with clear next steps and owners

• Lead strategic planning sessions and QBRs

• Run projects across your accounts: plan the work, coordinate internal teams and client stakeholders, and keep delivery on time and in scope

• Partner with the Implementation Manager to keep builds on track, acting as the link between what the client needs and what gets delivered

• Track account health across your portfolio, spot risks early, and bring a point of view on how to solve them

• Own the operational side of account management (support tickets, bug triage and routine requests) so nothing falls through the cracks

• Look for better ways of working, with clients and inside Quorso , and test new ideas

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

• Enterprise account experience: 4+ years managing relationships with large enterprise customers

• Strong project management: ability to run several projects at once, coordinate with multiple internal and external stakeholders, and keep delivery on track

• Stakeholder management: you’re comfortable working across complex client organizations, aligning people with different priorities and keeping senior stakeholders informed

• Ownership: a track record of driving initiatives to measurable outcomes without waiting to be asked

• Clear, confident communication: you run a good meeting and earn clients’ trust on your own

NICE TO HAVE

• Renewals experience: you’ve owned or supported renewal conversations with enterprise customers

• Reporting and business cases: you’re comfortable with data, can build clear reports, and can turn account metrics into a business case a client’s leadership will act on

• Retail operations background: hands-on experience in store operations or distribution centers, so you understand how retail teams work, the pressures they face, and how to speak their language

Don’t check every box? If you’re excited about the role and bring most of this, we’d still like to hear from you.
HOW WE WORK

• We’re drivers: everyone here owns outcomes and moves the dial for our customers and the business
